title: Initial scan state
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $st$ be a verifier state for $N$. The initial-scan predicate holds exactly when $st$ is an accepting verifier state, its head-position component is the initial machine state at tape position $0$, and its final Boolean component is true.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols
